mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the federal funds rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances when real GDP growth declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within two months signals a strengthening supply side, leading to increased productivity and corporate earnings, which in turn drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when industrial production increases by more than 1% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 1% within the same quarter, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and GDPC1 increase > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both housing starts and real GDP increase by the specified amounts within the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% within a year, it signals a potential inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increase > 2% in 1 year
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the federal funds rate is below 1% and the consumer price index increases by more than 2% within a year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, which in turn drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances when nonfarm payrolls increase for three consecutive months.
